label: Buy a fish
plays: When you buy and place a fish.

label: Drop food
plays: When you drop a food pellet. Fires often, so keep it short and quiet.

label: Building ejects an item
want: A soft ejecting sound (not a menu-closing blip)
plays: When a Refinery or Manufacturer ejects its output, or a Collector finishes a Science Flask.

label: Delete a building
want: A grounded thud or muted crack
plays: When you delete or replace a building.

label: Turret fires
want: A less harsh blip, or an electric pew
plays: Every turret shot. Plays up to 4 at once and very often, so it must stay soft and short.

label: Alien takes a hit
plays: When a click or turret shot damages an alien without killing it.

label: Alien dies
plays: When an alien dies.

label: Bank a coin
want: A more organic, non-harsh coin chink (current one is not bad)
plays: When a coin is banked by click or by a Collector. Fires very often.

label: Alien portal opens (new)
plays: New sound for when an alien portal opens before a wave spawns (about 1 second).

label: Wave warning (new)
plays: New sound that plays once, 10 seconds before an alien wave (when the countdown banner appears).

label: UI hover blip (new)
plays: New sound when the mouse moves over a UI or shop button. Fires constantly, so it must be tiny, very quiet and short (under 100 ms).

label: Select / click an item (new)
plays: New sound when you pick something from the Shop or Tank menu, or choose the Food tool or a Favorite slot. Fires often, so keep it short and soft.

label: Deselect / put back (new)
want: A softer, lower or reversed counterpart to the select sound
plays: New sound when you deselect the tool or item under the cursor: right-click, Q, or clicking an already-selected shop item. Only plays instead of (never together with) the select sound.

label: Water ambience loop (new)
want: A seamless, calm underwater ambience that loops
plays: New looping background track under the whole game, on its own Ambience volume slider in Settings (the slider comes once you have picked a loop). Longer files are fine (30 s to a few minutes). Play loops it; use Seam to hear the loop point, and Trim > Seamless loop crossfade to fix a clicky seam.

label: Unlock / buy an upgrade
plays: When you buy a Mound crack, a Science Lab node, a Tank Upgrade, an achievement Claim, or a hat (buy or equip). Fairly rare, so it can be bigger and more celebratory than the other sounds. Until you pick a file, a rising-arpeggio synth plays.

label: New chat message (new)
plays: When a new message arrives in the chat. Messages are fairly rare but can come in a cluster, so keep it short and gentle (the game also limits it to one per quarter second).

label: Fish eats
plays: Whenever a fish eats Food or Waste. Extremely frequent, so keep it tiny, quiet and short.

label: Fish gets very hungry
plays: When a fish reaches its second hunger stage (the "!!" icon). It repeats 4 times as hunger worsens; the game makes each repeat 15% louder than the last.

label: Fish starves
plays: When a fish dies of hunger.

label: Fish killed by an alien
want: A sudden, harsher sound than starving
plays: When an alien finishes off a fish.

label: Place a building
plays: When a building is placed or replaced (the drop-in thud plays separately when it lands).

label: Cannot afford it
plays: When you try to buy something (Food, a fish, a building) without enough money.

label: Production blocked (cap full)
plays: When a fish finishes a Science brew but the Science cap is already full.

label: Tank Point earned
plays: When a fish reaches adulthood and awards a Tank Point (plays together with the Grow to adult chime).

label: Fish grows to mid-size
plays: When a fish grows from baby to mid-size.

label: Fish grows to adult
want: A more magical chime than the mid-size one
plays: When a fish reaches full adult size (also on every merge or splice result).

label: Open a window / panel
plays: Opening any window or popup (Shop, Tank Upgrades, Science Lab, pause menu, recipe/filter/chest/info popups, the Mound).

label: Close a window / panel
plays: Closing any window or popup.

label: Building takes in an item
plays: When a Collector, Refinery, Manufacturer, Power Plant, Turret or Storage Chest pulls an item in. Fires often in a busy base, so keep it quiet and short.

label: Fin Sanity intro sting
plays: The title-screen sting that plays once when the intro starts (it counts as a sound effect, on the Sounds slider). Gain only: the game plays audio/Fin Sanity.mp3.

label: Building drop-in thud
plays: The landing sound when a placed building drops in. Gain only: the game plays audio/Drop.mp3 (it used to be fixed at 1.5x).
